page_title: LEV 0-0 STU | Bayer Leverkusen v Stuttgart 01/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+4' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is caught offside once again.
90+1' The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
86' Substitution. Victor Boniface walks off the pitch and Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as a substitute.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch so that Robert Andrich can be given a rest.
86' Xabi Alonso has decided to substitute Jeremie Frimpong and he is replaced by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
84' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) sends a chip pass into the box, but Lukas Hradecky is quickest to intercept the ball.

81' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Lukas Hradecky inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but was denied by a great save. Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
80' Enzo Millot goes off the pitch and Ameen Al Dakhil (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
80' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) replaces El Bilal Toure.
79' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) controls a rebound and tries to catch the keeper out from long range, but it's a poor effort that sails high over the bar.

77' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alexander Nubel with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
75' What a beautiful long-range strike by Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart). He is quite unlucky as his shot flies just over the bar.
74' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to release Florian Wirtz with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
73' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom right corner is thwarted by Alexander Nubel.

71' The cross into the penalty area from Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
71' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bayer Leverkusen was in an offside position.
70' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) sends a chip pass into the box, but Lukas Hradecky is quickest to intercept the ball.
69' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
68' Anrie Chase (VfB Stuttgart) unnecessarily kicks the ball off the pitch. Anrie Chase (VfB Stuttgart) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
66' Great ball in from Florian Wirtz. Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the right post.
66' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

65' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety. Good work from Bayer Leverkusen as they win a corner.
64' Daniel Siebert blows the whistle, Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) is penalised for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Bayer Leverkusen.
63' That's unlucky! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
63' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
61' Close! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
58' A pass from Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Alexander Nubel and the move breaks down.
58' Here is a change. Fabian Rieder is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).
58' Substitution. Maximilian Mittelstadt did his best and is replaced by Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart).
56' This is a yellow card! Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
56' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
54' Xabi Alonso is forced to make a change. Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Jonas Hofmann.
53' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the right post.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) was quite harsh and Daniel Siebert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) duly receives a yellow card.
48' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
48' The linesman makes the right call and Bayer Leverkusen will have a corner.
47' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
47' Handball by El Bilal Toure (VfB Stuttgart).
46' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Stuttgart.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Alexander Nubel.
45+2' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
45+1' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
42' Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a yellow card for infringement.
41' CHANCE! Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
41' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
41' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Bayer Leverkusen earn a corner.
40' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

40' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
38' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
37' The corner from Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is hurriedly cleared.
37' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. They send men into the box.
35' 5:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 2:0.
32' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) has a goal ruled out for offside!
30' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
29' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) takes it short.
28' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is repeatedly being caught offside.
27' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a defence-splitting pass from Granit Xhaka and shoots early from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes well wide of the left post.
26' The free kick is delivered by Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
25' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Stuttgart are awarded a free kick.
24' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
23' El Bilal Toure (VfB Stuttgart) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen earn a free kick.
23' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
19' Deniz Undav received a clever long ball from Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
18' A good run and leap by Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) to meet the corner from Alejandro Grimaldo ends in nothing, as the close-range header flies a mile wide of the left post.
18' The referee awards a corner and Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take it.

17' A cross from Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen can continue in their attacking effort.
17' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
15' Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
14' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Alexander Nubel is alert and denies him.
12' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Alexander Nubel.
10' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
9' The ball is cleared after Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Bayer Leverkusen force their opponents to concede a corner.
8' Sebastian Hoeness is forced to make a change. Jamie Leweling is unable to continue due to injury, Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
5' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
4' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
2' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
